conditions: Fixed crop sequence, calendar, native weather, soil, initial states and field access
Zero delivery to inaccessible fields; no inter-field transfer and no reservoir
Only pump/source/quota change; no field-access or crop substitution
fixed_policy_rainfed_bounds.argument: Induction on daily recurrence: inaccessible field receives0irrigation; next state depends only on its own prior state and fixed external inputs. Therefore its witnessed trajectory and maximum harvest ET deficit do not depend on pump/source/quota. Finite trajectory-hash equality is a countercheck, not the proof itself.
